title: HELIX Terminology: Enrollment Funnel Stage

codes.definition: Name purchased or scraped from College Board, ACT, NRCCUA, or other list source. No interaction yet.
Student has initiated contact: RFI form, campus visit request, email, test score send, or fair card.
Student has submitted an application for admission.
Student has paid enrollment deposit, confirming intent to enroll.
Student has completed orientation and/or registered for courses.
Student attended first day/census. Officially counted in enrollment.
Student confirmed/deposited but did not register or attend. Lost between confirmation and enrollment.
Student withdrew application or rescinded deposit before enrollment.

notes: The enrollment funnel is the primary framework for enrollment management. 'Summer melt' (confirmed students who don't show up) is a critical metric: typical melt rates are 10-20% at open-access institutions, 2-5% at selective institutions. Each stage transition represents a conversion rate that enrollment managers optimize.
